newsitem.title: EGYPT: CIB net profits up in first nine months.
newsitem.headline: CIB net profits up in first nine months.

text.p: Commercial International Bank (CIB) made net profits of 180.887 million pounds ($53.2 million) in the first nine months of calendar 1996 compared to 168.505 million in the same period of 1995, the bank said on Saturday.
The profits are equivalent to 36.18 pounds for each of the five million shares, which closed on the Egyptian stock exchange on Thursday at 445.50 a share.
Total assets at the end of the period amounted to 10.617 billion pounds, against 7.677 billion one year earlier.
Shareholders equity was worth 963.145 million pounds at the end of the nine months, against 856.418 million a year earlier, the bank said.
In the whole of 1995, the bank made profits of 218 million pounds and distributed a dividend of 20 pounds, plus one free share for every nine.
A tranche of the bank's shares have since gone on sale internationally through a global depositary receipt (GDR).
